title: OPTIC-ER: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Real-Time Emergency Response and Equitable Resource Allocation in Underserved African Communities
abstract: arXiv:2508.12943v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Public service systems in many African regions suffer from delayed emergency response and spatial inequity, causing avoidable suffering. This paper introduces OPTIC-ER, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for real-time, adaptive, and equitable emergency response. OPTIC-ER uses an attention-guided actor-critic architecture to manage the complexity of dispatch environments. Its key innovations are a Context-Rich State Vector, encoding action sub-optimality, and a Precision Reward Function, which penalizes inefficiency. Training occurs in a high-fidelity simulation using real data from Rivers State, Nigeria, accelerated by a precomputed Travel Time Atlas. The system is built on the TALS framework (Thin computing, Adaptability, Low-cost, Scalability) for deployment in low-resource settings. translated_title: OPTIC-ER：一个面向非洲欠发达社区实时应急响应与公平资源分配的强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 许多非洲地区的公共服务系统存在应急响应延迟和空间分配不公的问题，导致了本可避免的苦难。本文提出了OPTIC-ER，这是一个用于实现实时、自适应且公平应急响应的强化学习（RL）框架。OPTIC-ER采用注意力引导的Actor-Critic（演员-评论家）架构来应对调度环境的复杂性。其关键创新包括：一个编码动作次优性的“丰富上下文状态向量”，以及一个用于惩罚低效行为的“精确奖励函数”。系统训练在使用尼日利亚河流州真实数据构建的高保真仿真环境中进行，并通过预计算的“出行时间图集”进行加速。该系统基于TALS框架（精简计算、适应性、低成本、可扩展性）构建，适用于低资源环境的部署。在对500起未见事故的评估中，OPTIC-ER将应急响应时间缩短了35%以上，并优于62.94%的基线表现……
tldr: 本文提出强化学习框架OPTIC-ER，通过注意力引导的Actor-Critic架构与精确奖励函数，在低资源环境下实现非洲欠发达社区的实时公平应急响应，将响应时间缩短超过35%。
en_tdlr: OPTIC-ER is a reinforcement learning framework that achieves real-time, adaptive, and equitable emergency response in underserved African communities, reducing response times by over 35% through an attention-guided actor-critic architecture and a precision reward function.
